stories.title: In tit-for-tat move, Chaudhry Salik sends CM Maryam, Azma Bokhari defamation notices
stories.brief: In a tit-for-tat move, PML-Q leader and Overseas Pakistanis Minister Chaudhry Salik Hussain said on Monday he has also sent a defamation notice to Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz.

stories.title: Chaudhry Salik sends defamation notices to CM Maryam, Azma Bokhari amid corruption allegation row
stories.brief: "Attempts to intimidate through legal notices will neither silence nor deter me from raising concerns on matters of public interest and their well-being," he said. Hussain reiterated his allegations of corruption and mismanagement in Punjab, calling for accountability rather than what he described as attempts at intimidation.

stories.title: IHC directs petitioner to prove ownership of Bari Imam House to CDA
stories.brief: The court noted that the petitioner had produced no ownership documents, and that his counsel had candidly conceded that the relevant record lay with the CDA and the Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT) administration.

stories.title: IHC directs Bari Imam House caretaker to prove land ownership in five days
stories.brief: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Monday directed the caretaker of Bari Imam House to submit ownership documents for the property to the Capital Development Authority (CDA) within five days. The judge observed that the petitioner had obtained a stay order without even knowing the area of the land on which Bari Imam House stood.

stories.title: FCC conditionally allows PHC to hear cases under Article 199
stories.brief: Read: Federal Constitutional Court bars Peshawar High Court from hearing MPO detention cases The council also requested the FCC to clarify its Nov 5 order. stories.title: PM Shehbaz calls for collective efforts to tackle regional security threats in meeting with ECO FMs
stories.brief: Welcoming the visiting dignitaries, the prime minister thanked them for attending the meeting and reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to the organisation’s objectives, particularly regional cooperation, connectivity and economic integration. Pakistan's assumption of the ECO chairmanship comes amid persistent regional tensions and challenges to economic integration.
